preRegistered: squad17-core.mjs RULES + data/strategy-library.json SQ17-* (24 Oct 2026, before any run)
standard: PORTFOLIO (primary for this squad): CAGR per half (start - last close of 2023 / 2024 - last close) after 0.4% per side on all turnover (stress 0.6%) vs SPUS (primary) and SPY, price only for all; max drawdown; beatsSpusBothHalves / beatsSpyBothHalves. PER TRADE (TRY SMALL reads this; identical to Squad 5): each holding period = one trade, both halves: > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2%, better than the average liquid stock and than the same stock held as long on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5 (63-session blocks) -> TRADABLE SMALL; >= 4.07 -> PROVEN; plus return per year of capital above SPY in both halves. Gross returns capped at +300% both sides (AUD-1).
halalNote: The Shariah screen is a point-in-time PROXY (SIC business screen; debt, cash + short-term investments and receivables each < 33% of the 36-month average market value; interest income < 5% of revenue), NOT the ZAD status: no point-in-time ZAD history exists in the repository. Today's members carry the owner's ZAD mark and the HalalScreener result.
